summary: Closed Phase 11, the task's final phase, as [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]. Regenerated the deployed tree (deploy-headless.sh) and confirmed no task-number/record-versioning language in any touched file. Ran the complete gate set twice with an explicit source-store target resolved to the repo root (not the extension's own source_dir, which fails fast -- see handoff Key Decisions): run 1 at --jobs auto, run 2 at --jobs 2, both rc=1 with an identical '4 of 37 check(s) failed' summary line. Every finding across both runs traces to an already-documented pre-existing cause (gate3 lean4 doc-lint, gate4 task-reference lint, gate20 eager-load 988B over baseline, gate8's three named pre-existing suites plus one already-root-caused cascade); two additional transient findings (a gate4 timeout, a gate8 test-update-task-status.sh failure) surfaced only under live ambient contention from concurrent sibling sessions and were each confirmed to pass cleanly on an isolated standalone re-run, so neither is a regression. Re-confirmed stalled-gate/stalled-suite fixtures firing within bound and the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint's full three-branch contract, via existing standalone test suites (test-gate-registry-resolution.sh 26/26, test-run-all-selection.sh 19/19, test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh 24/24, test-orchestrate-batch-gate.sh 26/26, test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh 371/371) -- no additional full-battery cost beyond the two budgeted runs.
